0022600206.text: Toronto hosts Memphis in the Raptors' 10th game of the season, with the Raptors at 5-4 (2-1 at home) and sixth in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, while the Grizzlies are 6-3 (4-0 on the road), third in the Southwest and one game back in their division, and riding a three-game losing streak. The Raptors are without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while the Grizzlies are missing Isaiah Stewart (out, knee bruise), Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and Toronto won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 128-96 regular-season win in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
